articles.headline: Team Gaffer Peter Gitau Outlines Tactical Ambitions For Nginda Warriors FC
articles.excerpt: Head Coach and Team Gaffer Peter Gitau emphasizes high-intensity tactical discipline, unity, and fearless attacking football as the squad steps up preparations.
articles.body:
Nginda Warriors FC Head Coach and Team Gaffer Peter Gitau has spoken passionately about the club's trajectory, praising the players' dedication and tactical adaptability.

"Our warrior spirit begins on the training pitch," said Coach Gitau. "We demand discipline, rapid transitions, and total commitment to the jersey. The community of Nginda deserves a football club that fights for every point and showcases genuine excellence on the pitch."

Under Coach Gitau's leadership, the Warriors continue rigorous training sessions focusing on match fitness, set-piece execution, and defensive solidity ahead of upcoming competitive league fixtures.
